## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting user-visible behavior.

## Validation

List commands, outcomes, OS, and architecture. Distinguish compilation,
simulator launch, and device testing. For mobile changes, include picker
cancellation, revoked access, rotation, and background/foreground checks.

## Limitations

Note relevant permission, size-semantics, accessibility, or localization limits.
Do not include private paths, provider grants, or signing credentials.
